title: Compact credential journey spritepack for API/SDK quickstart (auth, key rotation, streaming, tool-call)
creator: Marisol Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, modular spritepack of onboarding assets that demonstrates the credential and streaming flow for API/SDK quickstarts.

Deliverables:
- 6 primary artboards (token creation, token usage in SDK, rotating keys CTA, streaming handshake, tool-call wiring, error/fallback state).
- Light and dark theme exports at 1x/2x for doc embeds and inline screenshots.
- 2 annotated PNG screenshots sized for docs hero and in-line step captures.
- SVG component strips for use in the Quickstart React component.

Acceptance criteria:
- Visuals align with Redwood brand tokens and existing quickstart layout.
- Screenshots map to the final SDK code snippets (sync with ENG-19876).
- Assets export cleanly with transparent backgrounds for embedding and with separate overlay layers for callouts.

Notes on scope:
- This ticket focuses solely on the visual assets and annotated screenshots; implementation in docs will be tracked in PM and ENG follow-ups.

Edge cases and accessibility:
- Provide high-contrast variants for accessibility.
- Include caption text for each artboard to be pulled into docs localization flows.
